message.subject: Coffee Break in Bellevue
message.html:
Greetings Jishnu - My team will be in the Bellevue area June 10 to June 12 to start our remote office with me. We'll also be visiting our partners at Tagger Media to celebrate their $140M acquisition.

During the last 5 years, we delivered over 45 weekly meetings for their sales team, accounting for more than 50% of their current client base, including brands like Samsung, Intel, and Ralph Lauren.

Would love to chat about doing something similar for Cloudbaud.

Coffee catch-up?


Derek Jackson
Head of Growth
Key Outreach
